reviews.text: We have always been treated well and have been open about the reasonableness/profitability of the measures vs. price, etc. We have received the best service ❤️
Thank you for kind and proffesional service
I can recommend, really competent veterinary and care service! They know how to handle and care for cats 10+
Clean place and very friendly staff.
Really good service and the kitties loved it😻😻
Excellent service every time. Highly recommended!
At the veterinary clinic, my grumpy cat was welcomed with warmth and understanding. The blood test results came back quickly and I received good discharge instructions.
Good and friendly service in English and Finnish. We came to do the vaccination for the dog.
I can highly recommend it. The staff is very friendly, professional and empathetic. Our cat's euthanasia was carried out with respect for him and care for us. <3
Very friendly service. Good doctor, no robbery. The doctor gave different options on how to proceed. Reasonable prices.

Professional and warm staff. They took care of our scared cat calmly and with consideration for him and the owners. The care was very good and we were kept informed the whole time about what was happening and what to do next. Highly recommended!🥰
The staff was lovely and caring and I quickly received help with my pet's problem.
Very nice and good doctor and nursing staff. Thank you

My pet and I received very good service. I was particularly impressed by the veterinarian's gentleness and good animal handling skills. The nursing staff was also very customer service-minded, cheerful, competent and prompt.

Previous experiences
I have used Pups n Pets twice this year, at the dentist and for a catheterization.

My cat got kidney failure in February and I spent about 4000 euros on vet bills in a few months (I am unemployed).

I received this last visit as a pro bono visit, for which I am grateful. The friendly vet Garcia helped my cat with the problem of idiopathic cystitis.

Warm thanks from me and my cat named Jänis and best wishes for the rest of the summer!
Wonderful veterinarian Katariina Kangas, highly recommended❤️

Good care for the dog. The doctor and nurse were really attentive to the sick patient. The diagnosis was made and the patient is already better.
Reasonable prices for a veterinarian.
Friendly, professional and reasonably priced
Great service and nice staff! :)
Pleasant and professional service.
Friendly and considerate of your own pet. Also experienced in dental care.
Familiar and safe veterinary clinic. Nice and knowledgeable veterinarians. I recommend!

Great service, all our questions were answered. Our dog’s surgery was very smooth, extremely small scar. They did everything to make her comfortable and cared for. This was the 2nd procedure for our dog here and every time was very good.
Ver very nice doctors! They will care about your pet ❤️❤️❤️
Our concerns and questions were answered expertly, the service was friendly, and the pets were greeted warmly. We received good care for our two Coton boys. 🐾 …
The doctor was nice and the cat received good care.
A wonderful nurse and doctor were at our visit and they were able to take into account the exciting rescue perfectly! Thank you very much <3

Location, service/professionalism and price.
All good!
Reliable expertise.

Expert and pleasant service. Flexible and informative activities. I chose the clinic because of the good reviews and I was not disappointed! Everything was fixed at once despite the findings and the instructions to the house were understandable and easy. The location was easily accessible and the car was easily parked on the side of the road.
The price / quality ratio was very pleasant.
I took a dental package for my 10-year-old Mauno.
The operation included anesthesia, X-rays, tartar removal and 4 teeth extraction, as well as blood tests. The operation also removed an inflammatory plaque from the gum. For a total price of €890, I am very satisfied with the work done. I also booked a check-up visit at the pick-up, which is included in the price. This gave me additional reassurance, a positive and professional feeling that the dog is doing well and is recovering well.
Booking was easy via the website and appointments were very available. The cat received a triple vaccination and a quick health check.

Very much recommended!

Reasonable pricing.

Extremely understanding staff, very knowledgeable and empathetic. Cares for the well-being of both the pet and the owner, communicating clearly all the costs, procedures and explaining conditions and so on.

Clean and modern clinic with holistic approach.
The dental treatment went well and another minor problem was also taken care of. Thank you very much!
Thank you, we were super satisfied.
Always professional and friendly service.
The surgery went well, things were explained clearly and the service was friendly in general 😊 Later, I received additional instructions and help quickly via WhatsApp. Thank you 😊 …
Rambo finally got the right diagnosis, really thorough and great customer service and vet, thank you! ❤️
Friendly and professional care.
Goofy the cat received good dental care and follow-up care. Nice and empathetic staff 😻 …
We've already visited the lovely Leea several times for skin and allergy checks and she always provides really competent and friendly service - even the dog is always excited to go to the vet☺️

Professional and friendly service.
Luna was taken care of by Leea Fraktman.
Lovely staff and professional service. Highly recommended. Dog and owner thank you 😊 …
Highly recommend this place. My old dog had his teeth cleaned here and it's easy to trust when they have the latest new technology.
Nice and knowledgeable staff. The rescue dog was also well received.

They would have wanted to make more money by doing expensive and dangerous additional procedures that would probably kill an elderly dog.

3 ⭐⭐⭐ because this is how all veterinarians and staff work anyway.

otherwise it's ok. It would be good if patients and their relatives/owners knew more about healthcare and influenced the quality of care, right? Just happy comments.
Very knowledgeable staff.
We took our cat for a routine vaccination appointment. Great place, clean, comfortable, and on-time, with no delays. The veterinarian is qualified. We plan to continue visiting this clinic.
Lovely staff. ❤️ They were so understanding and knew how to be nice to everyone. I always come there with my dogs and cats for health checkups.
Amazing service, good care. Remember they are not open on sudays 😊 Best doctord, friendly service! Very good! I recommend for everyone …
